drills.drills.qcf_punch.title: Quarter Circle Forward / QCF
drills.drills.qcf_punch.description: Roll from down to forward, then finish with a punch-family attack.
drills.drills.qcb_kick.title: Quarter Circle Back / QCB
drills.drills.qcb_kick.description: Roll from down to back, then finish with a kick-family attack.
drills.drills.dpf_punch.title: Dragon Punch Forward / DPF
drills.drills.dpf_punch.description: Tap forward, move to down, then finish on down-forward with punch.
drills.drills.dpb_kick.title: Dragon Punch Back / DPB
drills.drills.dpb_kick.description: Tap back, move to down, then finish on down-back with kick.
drills.drills.charge_back_forward_punch.title: Charge Back Forward
drills.drills.charge_back_forward_punch.descrip: Hold back long enough, snap to forward, then press punch.
drills.drills.charge_down_up_kick.title: Charge Down Up
drills.drills.charge_down_up_kick.description: Hold down long enough, jump to up, then press kick.
drills.drills.double_qcf_punch.title: Double Quarter Circle Forward
drills.drills.double_qcf_punch.description: Complete two quarter-circle-forward motions before the punch input.
drills.drills.double_qcb_kick.title: Double Quarter Circle Back
drills.drills.double_qcb_kick.description: Complete two quarter-circle-back motions before the kick input.
